history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1833 in the North of Ireland and came to Chicago about 1866. He works as a harness maker, and the household lives near Lake Street and the river. The family's church is St. James's.
